sourceAuthority: Visible preliminary quantity model, requiring approved crossing design, geotechnical information, product selection and method statement
scope: One continuous steel casing crossing with explicitly selected installation method. Casing supply and site joints, support rings and elements, contact tape, compatible end-seal kits, applicable civil work, crew labor, mechanisms and logistics are separate quantity/cost owners. This source pack is not itself a published owner or accepted estimate.

quantityComponent.trenchFillMaterialBoundary: One explicitly selected granular product for the open trench only. Existing gross trench minus bedding/casing and actual other non-overlapping permanent occupation/restoration layers gives net finished space. Confirmed reuse in finished-volume equivalent is disjoint from compatible loose stock. Actual gross supplied-loose ratio includes all process losses; reserve/stock/supply multiple yield rounded new order and retained/free remainder. Only new supplied-loose order owns material cost. Mixed/layered/other fills, approved suitability, execution and soil haul remain open. Missing original facts are local needs and cannot be replaced by a manual order.
quantityComponent.carrierAndMechanicalBoundary: Actual carrier product and total end extensions are distinct from casing length/stock/section supply. Explicit customer supply creates no executor pipe purchase. Selected new whole carrier sections have distinct damage, compatible allocated stock, retained reserve, physical section length and supplier bundle counts; only new ordered carrier metres own pipe cost, excluding connections/people/equipment/energy/freight. Installed pipe length includes actual end extensions, but internal insertion uses crossing length only. Mechanical preparation and open-cut lowering use installed casing sections, supports use installed rings, end kit installation uses two actual scoped ends; supplier rounding/reserve/stock never inflate mechanical work. Project method, compatible equipment/access/lifting/traction/cost-boundary facts remain required under manual hours. Jacking loading, preparation consumables, carrier joints and engineering approval remain open; no full owner/publication acceptance.
quantityComponent.internalExecutionAndWaterBoundary: Selected full dry internal fill uses original installed net internal geometry for actual disjoint mixing/placing crew and equipment rates. Dry stock/reserve/bag surplus do not change placing hours. Existing water consumption comes only from actual consumed dry kg and selected mixing litres per net-mass bag. Explicit customer-supplied water creates no executor purchase; explicit separate compatible water supply uses disjoint allocated m3 stock/reserve/multiple/new order/remainder and only its new order owns water cost. Water approval/allocation and supply cost boundary remain actual facts; powder, crew, equipment, energy and delivery are excluded from water price. Original mixing/geometry facts and selected technology remain required even under manual paid quantities. Pressure/buoyancy/restraints, curing, delivery and project approval remain open; not full-owner acceptance.

civilExecutionAndStageMatrix.scope: Selected open-trench excavation, thrust/reception pit excavation and combined drive/soil-removal jacking system; actual pit dimensions are separate from drive length and bore volume
civilExecutionAndStageMatrix.quantities: Existing geometric excavation times selected total-crew person-hours or selected equipment-hours per unit; jacking advance uses drive metres, not pit/bore double counting
civilExecutionAndStageMatrix.inputAuthority: Applicable method statement, ground/access conditions, actual selected equipment and disjoint cost bases; no universal rate or synthetic fixture default
civilExecutionAndStageMatrix.costBoundary: All personnel including operators in crew only; equipment excludes all personnel and includes its energy. Shoring, reaction structures, water control and logistics remain separate unresolved owners
civilExecutionAndStageMatrix.manualBoundary: A direct manual hour exception retains its provenance but cannot replace unknown original geometry, selected technology or equipment compatibility
civilExecutionAndStageMatrix.matrixBoundary: Every declared resource belongs to exactly one stage. Concrete absent resources remain listed; this is not full-owner or engineering acceptance

fillExecutionBoundary.scope: Selected granular bedding and selected pit OR open-trench fill placement/compaction; method, product and actual disjoint crew/equipment rates required
fillExecutionBoundary.basis: Installed finished geometry including approved reused material, never supplied loose volume, reserve, stock, order packs or surplus. Trench occupation and individual pit occupation stay original authoritative facts even under manual hours
fillExecutionBoundary.independence: Unknown supply ratio or approved reuse allocation gates the dependent purchase/consumption, not already known finished-geometry placement work
fillExecutionBoundary.costBoundary: All personnel including operators are in crew only; equipment excludes all personnel and includes energy. Material/water supply, delivery and soil haul are separate. No universal rates/defaults
fillExecutionBoundary.remaining: Actual layer/material/moisture/water-quality suitability and disjoint allocation and compaction method approval, mixed/other materials, engineering acceptance and full-owner publication

freight.scope: Selected casing/carrier section orders, loose bedding/pit/trench fill, dry internal mix, separately purchased mixing/compaction water, inspection couplant and stakes/marking paint; each actual off-site stock allocation is a distinct documented delivery lane
freight.quantity: Use the existing rounded order, including retained reserve and supplier surplus. Do not use installed quantities or call supplier multiples vehicle trips. Site stock creates no stock haul; off-site portion cannot exceed compatible allocated stock
freight.capacity: Minimum of actual vehicle placement capacity and actual legal payload divided by certified shipping mass including packaging. Whole sections remain indivisible in both lanes; new supplier dry/consumable packs remain whole. Already allocated usable stock in opened containers follows its own documented packaging and actual shipping mass/placement plan. Whole section length fits the vehicle/route. Geometric steel mass never substitutes for shipping mass
freight.cost: One separately documented full cargo round trip includes vehicle, driver, energy, loading, unloading and return. Material and installation stay separate. Explicit other-party delivery creates no second executor charge. Consolidated loads require a separate manifest; do not price the same shared trip twice
freight.applicability: The common inclusion resolver uses the bounded canonical FormulaGraph to decide whether shipment is positive. Zero shipment excludes route/truck questions. Missing original inputs remain local needs; manual trips cannot bypass source geometry, mass, route, cost basis or stock compatibility
freight.remaining: Actual project transport/route evidence and prices, consolidated manifests, remaining fittings/consumables freight, equipment mobilization/demobilization, heterogeneous/slurry allocation and additional soil handling, marker waste, full-owner purchase-exception reconciliation and governed publication

quantityComponent.inputPolicy: The component takes explicitly supplied scalar inputs and does not create a runtime form or baseline. The full owner must classify source-backed replaceable assumptions separately from genuine project facts, and prefer certified pipe mass when available.

integration of actual method-specific civil work, support/reaction arrangement, groundwater measures and approved pit return-fill technology/material and execution resources

internal fill product/method approval, buoyancy/pressure/restraints/bulkheads and placing/mixing/cleaning/curing resources, disjoint water supply and logistics; partial/other fill and external overbreak grout remain separate unimplemented scopes

soilStateAllocationAndHaul.scope: One explicitly confirmed homogeneous excavated batch in the existing open-trench or pits-plus-actual-bore branch; heterogeneous materials, slurry and other fill technologies remain separately scoped
soilStateAllocationAndHaul.states: Original geometric in-situ volume times actual project loose/in-situ conversion. Existing approved finished reuse is allocated by documented current/external/partial origin; only actual partial allocation is an additional fact. Current reuse uses a separate actual loose/finished conversion including process losses. Retained loose material for other site purposes is disjoint; excess = excavated loose - allocated current reuse loose - retained loose. Supplied stock/reserve/order surplus never becomes excavated soil
soilStateAllocationAndHaul.haul: Only positive excess activates destination/classification/receiver, dedicated route and actual cost owner. Capacity is min(actual vehicle loose capacity, legal payload/actual moist shipping density), trips rounded upward. One full dedicated trip includes vehicle/personnel/energy/loading/unloading/return and excludes excavation/placing/receiving
soilStateAllocationAndHaul.receiving: Explicit other-party receiving creates no charge. Separate receiving owns only excess loose m3 OR actual tonnes from moist shipping density, excluding transport and other execution; no invented disposal permission, prices or generic density
soilStateAllocationAndHaul.independence: Known bank/loose excavation remains calculable with unavailable fill/reuse data. Dependent balance/trips/receiving retain original geometry, actual state facts, suitability/allocation and route/receiver/cost boundaries even under manual paid quantities. Explicit zero reuse disables origin/conversion; zero excess disables truck/destination/receiving facts. Negative allocation is rejected rather than clamped
soilStateAllocationAndHaul.open: Material/technology/design/classification acceptance, mixed/slurry allocation, extra sorting/site handling, all other stage gaps and governed full-owner publication remain open

compactionWater.scope: Actual gross added water for the selected bedding or same-granular trench/pit fill, including initial moisture and process losses, in litres per installed finished m3; dust control, dewatering and internal grout mixing are other scopes
compactionWater.resources: Original finished geometry including reused material determines actual consumed water, never supplied loose order/reserve. All personnel/equipment applying water are in existing selected placement execution once. Explicit suitable other-party supply creates no executor purchase; separate suitable exclusive stock/reserve/supplier multiple yields new ordered m3, remaining and free remainder
compactionWater.freight: Shared dedicated transport owns actual new water cargo and separately allocated off-site water stock, with certified shipping mass, legal payload and actual placement capacity. Supplier billing multiple is not a vehicle load or delivery trip
compactionWater.integrity: Unknown actual added-water rate is a local need and not zero. Explicit zero disables dependent supply/quality/transport facts while retaining values. Missing packaging does not block known consumption or execution. Manual water purchase preserves original geometry, placement method, actual rate, quality and exclusive allocation/cost gates
compactionWater.open: Actual material/moisture/water quality acceptance, exclusive project allocation, actual equipment/application methods and prices, other/layered fills and governed full-owner publication remain open

stakingResources.scope: Explicit actual straight-axis plan using one stake and separate marking paint per point; other-party scope has no duplicate executor charge and other layouts require their own program
stakingResources.quantity: Both ends once: ceil(original crossing length/actual maximum pitch)+1 axis points, plus actual disjoint off-axis points. Actual replacement events add material and replacement work only. Initial control/layout/install/mark and final removal use initial points; replacement includes removing failed old markers so those are not removed twice at completion
stakingResources.resources: Separate compatible crew/instrument hours and actual disjoint procedures. Stakes distinguish installations/replacements from actual pre-install unusable pieces; paint uses actual gross kg per installation including losses once. Compatible allocated pre-work stock, reserve, net supply packages, new order and unused/free remainder remain separate; only new material order owns purchase cost
stakingResources.freight: Existing shared dedicated delivery applies to new stake pieces/new whole paint packages and separately allocated off-site stock. Actual shipping mass and load plan never come from a guessed material density
stakingResources.integrity: Original geometry/program/product/cost boundaries survive manual paid quantities. Missing pitch remains local while casing/civil quantities calculate; missing supply pack blocks purchase only, not known material consumption or labor. Zero replacements disable only replacement facts; inactive values survive in the common editor
stakingResources.open: Actual control/design acceptance, other layouts, clearance/site preparation, applicable fencing/traffic, recovered-marker inventory, marker waste transport/receiving, execution/price approval and governed full-owner publication remain open

initialJointInspection.scope: Initial visual or initial visual plus manually applied UT under an actual project-selected compatible procedure; other methods and actual defect repair/reinspection remain separate
initialJointInspection.quantity: Existing installed physical sections minus one determines site joints, never supplier packs or reserve. Only actual UT program fraction 0..1 determines ceil(site joints*fraction) whole initially selected joints; no generic mandatory fraction or defect prediction
initialJointInspection.resources: Distinct all-inspector person-hours and compatible equipment-hours with energy, original WPS/casing geometry/procedure/program/access/qualification gates. Actual compatible couplant gross kg per selected joint includes process losses once; stock/reserve/net supply pack/new order/remaining/free remainder use distinct same-state quantities; only new kg order owns material cost
initialJointInspection.freight: Existing dedicated freight owner applies to rounded new couplant order and separately allocated off-site usable stock. New packages indivisible; opened usable stock follows its own documented actual shipping mass and placement plan, never forced to new pack mass. Whole physical pipe sections remain indivisible in both lanes
initialJointInspection.integrity: Missing selected UT fraction leaves known visual resources and independent material orders. Manual quantities retain original source/geometry/program/material cost gates. Zero UT selection and no site joints disable corresponding facts while retaining previous values. Other-party program records its boundary without a second executor charge
initialJointInspection.notAccepted: No NDT method adequacy, qualification, quality acceptance, repair rate, environmental coating or full-owner publication inferred

primarySources.role: Section 152 distinguishes survey/control, marking, maintenance/replacement and removal; sections 204/301/302/725 distinguish moisture conditioning and suitable construction water
primarySources.basis: A survey program maintains/replaces usable temporary markings and removes them at completion. Selected placement requires actual moisture conditioning and suitable water without detrimental substances
primarySources.restriction: No US legal applicability, tolerance, point pitch, moisture target, productivity, added-water/material rate or acceptance is transplanted into the project. All selected facts remain explicit; this component does not replace actual project control/material acceptance

primarySources.role: Example distinction between preblended dry powder, mixed yield, actual mixing water and usable dry stock; not approval for casing filling
primarySources.basis: The manufacturer specifies powder packaging, mixed yield and water addition separately, and restricts storage and application conditions.
primarySources.restriction: No Sika designation, example rate, bag size, water ratio or application range is a runtime default or proof of casing-fill suitability. Use the actual project-approved product/method facts; do not count preblended constituents again or assume wet grout is reusable dry inventory.

primarySources.role: RACI-specific spacer selection and ring-layout rules
primarySources.basis: Selection depends on carrier and joint envelope diameters, casing internal diameter, clearance, filled carrier weight and crossing length. The manufacturer's preliminary ring rule is length/approved spacing+3; two rings protect each end.
primarySources.restriction: Do not apply RACI geometry, terminal rings or selection limits to other spacer systems. Diameter alone does not select a load-rated element. An approved layout and selected element remain project facts. Integer rounding is the application's conservative preliminary procurement rule, not a quoted universal installation norm.

primarySources.basis: Approved spacing depends on filled-pipe load and is at most 3 m for this system. A single tape course covers each ring's pipe circumference with width at least the selected ring width; an additional adjacent course is allowed by the manufacturer when required, but is outside the implemented single-course component. Installation follows the quotation/order layout.
primarySources.restriction: Provided tape must not be purchased twice. Tape width and the selected ring geometry require product confirmation; preliminary quantities do not establish structural adequacy.

primarySources.role: Example end-seal kit scope and included fasteners
primarySources.basis: The EPDM casing-end kit includes stainless fastening straps and protects the annular space from dirt and moisture.
primarySources.restriction: This is not a pressure-rated or universally groundwater-tight seal. Match the exact carrier/casing combination. Included straps have informational scope only, not a second purchase.

primarySources.role: Preliminary steel density for geometric transport mass
primarySources.basis: Approximate density 7.85 g/cm3 converts to 7850 kg/m3.
primarySources.restriction: The actual selected pipe's certified unit mass takes precedence. This physical approximation does not select grade, wall thickness or casing capacity.

primarySources.role: Welding consumption and disjoint cost-basis boundary, not project rates
primarySources.basis: Deposited metal differs from purchased consumable mass. Actual process/product losses and operating time must be distinguished from joint setup, total crew work and equipment costs.
primarySources.restriction: No published illustrative factor or productivity is installed as a universal default. The component accepts explicit approved gross consumption and aggregate crew/equipment rates. Joint preparation, fit-up and inspection remain separately owned.

primarySources.role: Prevents a core-wire efficiency percentage from becoming gross purchased-electrode recovery
primarySources.basis: MMA electrode efficiency may compare deposited mass to core-wire mass and exceed 100 percent because the coating contributes metal.
primarySources.restriction: Do not treat that percentage as the fraction of total purchased coated-electrode mass recovered, invert it into a generic purchase factor or charge process losses twice.

primarySources.role: Distinct excavation, loose and finished-volume states; not a project conversion factor
primarySources.basis: Earthwork design distinguishes in-situ, loose and embankment material states and uses project geotechnical characteristics for volume changes.
primarySources.restriction: No illustrative FHWA factor, density or range is installed as a universal norm. This arithmetic component requires actual gross supplied-volume conversion and explicit finished-volume reuse without claiming project engineering acceptance.

primarySources.role: Material suitability boundary, not permission to reuse all excavated soil
primarySources.basis: Fill material must meet applicable quality and compaction requirements; some soil types or contaminated/deleterious materials are unsuitable.
primarySources.restriction: A geometric excavation volume proves neither reusable quantity nor product suitability. Only explicitly confirmed compatible reuse in finished-volume equivalent is deducted; classification, testing and placement approval remain external project facts.

primarySources.role: Method-specific work boundary and unknown project facts
primarySources.basis: Pipe jacking requires method-sized thrust/reception pits and a designed reaction arrangement; groundwater conditions can require additional seals and measures.
primarySources.restriction: No pit geometry, thrust capacity, geotechnical condition or groundwater measure is inferred from crossing length. Open-cut and trenchless scopes are not charged together.

primarySources.role: Distinct visual and ultrasonic testing methods and actual selected inspection procedures
primarySources.basis: Inspection methods test actual material/component characteristics without turning an inspection document into labor, equipment or consumables
primarySources.restriction: No project sample fraction, generic couplant rate, inspection productivity, inspector qualification or quality acceptance is installed

primarySources.role: Actual defect characterization and compatible repair/reinspection procedures
primarySources.basis: Repair depends on actual defect size, position, material, method and inspection requirements
primarySources.restriction: Do not invent a universal defect percentage, charge hypothetical repairs as initial work or assume passing quality acceptance

projectFacts: one continuous crossing length and confirmed installation method
selected steel casing designation, outside and inside diameters
carrier outside diameter and maximum bell/flange/coupling envelope
selected load-rated spacer element, approved ring pitch and actual element height; assembled diameter is calculated, not another independent question
planned physical casing section length; not supplier bundle size
method-specific excavation dimensions, support and reaction arrangements
actual groundwater and optional annular-fill requirements

explicit internal-fill mode; full-dry-product branch needs actual non-overlapping internal occupation beyond the carrier cylinder, approved product designation, gross dry kg/net m3 including losses, usable dry stock/reserve, bag net kg and actual mixing litres for that same bag; no hidden no-fill or dry-product default
external excavation dimensions for the selected rectangular method; usable pit dimensions are not substituted for excavation dimensions
actual selected jacking excavation diameter; it is not inferred from casing OD
actual approved full-width bedding thickness for the open rectangular branch; no hidden bedding or pit size

each selected rectangular jacking pit's actual non-overlapping permanent occupied volume includes retained structures, casing ends and other excluded fill; temporary equipment is not permanent occupation and unknown is never zero

explicit same-granular product branch for both pits, confirmed compatible reuse in finished-volume equivalent, actual gross supplied-loose conversion and disjoint loose stock/reserve/supply multiple; other/mixed products need their own scope

selected granular bedding, actual gross loose-volume consumption including all compaction/process losses, compatible same-state loose stock/reserve and supplier volume multiple; no universal compaction factor
applicable approved MMA WPS, selected electrode, actual gross kg/joint including process losses, usable compatible stock/reserve and actual net pack mass
aggregate joint crew person-hours excluding separately owned material/equipment cost; actual equipment hours with all personnel excluded and energy included

dimensionPolicy.geometry: metres, square metres and cubic metres; explicit conversions for mm, kg and tonnes
dimensionPolicy.pipeWall: (casing outside diameter - casing inside diameter)/2; do not ask for a second independent wall thickness
dimensionPolicy.raciAssembledDiameter: carrier OD + 2 * selected RACI element height; do not ask for a second independent assembled diameter
dimensionPolicy.raciDiametralDifferences: assembled diameter - maximum joint envelope > 15 mm AND casing ID - assembled diameter > 15 mm; strict manufacturer-specific diametral limits, not radial clearances or structural approval
dimensionPolicy.invalidGeometry: Reject nonpositive wall or insufficient assembled clearance; never conceal it by max(0, geometry)
dimensionPolicy.civilGeometry: Rectangular excavation length*width*depth; mm2 bore/casing area converted at the final volume. Open-cut outside fill space excludes bedding and full exterior casing displacement, not merely steel wall mass
dimensionPolicy.civilBoundary: Geometric nonnegative differences prove only dimensional feasibility, not engineering cover, shoring safety, reaction capacity, groundwater adequacy or material suitability
dimensionPolicy.internalFill: pi/4*(casing ID^2-carrier OD^2)*crossing length/1000000 minus actual non-overlapping occupied m3; keep mm2 until final conversion, never use outside excavation or assume spacers/bells occupy zero

procurementPolicy.siteJoints: physical sections minus one for this continuous straight casing; no inferred additional branches
procurementPolicy.stock: Only whole confirmed compatible casing sections; unidentified offcuts do not count as available installation stock
procurementPolicy.supplierBundles: A bundle contains an integer number of compatible physical sections. Round new section demand by bundle count without changing installed sections or joints
procurementPolicy.balance: Installed quantity, cutting/process loss, retained reserve, compatible stock, rounded new order and free remainder are distinct visible outputs
procurementPolicy.endSealFasteners: Included kit straps are not independently payable or procurement-eligible
procurementPolicy.selectedProductSupplies: Explicit installed count + actual technological loss + retained reserve minus compatible stock; new order rounded to actual pack/roll size, remaining after installation and loss separated from free surplus
procurementPolicy.providedTape: Confirmed compatible metres per newly ordered element pack multiplied by the actual new element pack count; deduct from extra tape order, not a second priced purchase
procurementPolicy.tapeScope: One full-width circumferential course only; actual tape width >= selected ring width. Unknown width remains a local resource need, and a manual quantity cannot remove the product-input gate

profilePolicy.presentation: Effective values are actually filled in editable inputs, with a separate preliminary-source label and grey format/source guidance
profilePolicy.approval: Labor, productivity, consumption, loss, reserve, packaging and supplied-kit assumptions are editable scenario inputs, not universal standards or approved engineering decisions
profilePolicy.cost: Each resource's explicit cost basis owns personnel, energy and materials once. Selected civil execution keeps all personnel including operators in crew, and energy in personnel-excluded equipment. An all-in equipment rate cannot be combined with that separate crew basis. No duplicate fuel/power owner

excludedScope: carrier pipeline purchase and installation outside the casing
pavement reconstruction and road traffic management unless separately and explicitly owned
automatic structural/geotechnical design, thrust-force approval or groundwater safety certification
HDD, pipe ramming or another method silently substituted for confirmed pipe jacking
grout net volume asserted from gross annular geometry without accounting for actual occupied volume
cost aggregation with a parent pipeline before crossing-specific trench and insertion overlaps are reconciled
